第21章 我该怎么配合表演（第1页）
看见林琅天表态，君有情心底暗“哼”一声，“算你小子识相，有眼光”口中却是说道：
“既然林公子同意，那这事就算定下了，明天就举行大婚如何？”
“一切全凭父亲做主”君怡雪娇羞说道；
君有情看向林琅天，林琅天马上会意，“但凭君伯父做主，小子绝无二话”
“嗯”看见局面往想象中发展，君有情也是暗松口气。
“好了，关于婚礼事情解决，林家小子，我有一事不明想问问你？”十八祖终于出声了。
林琅天心中一突，预感不好的事终于来了，还好自己已有腹案，否则真不知道会怎么样。
“十八祖，有何疑惑，小子但凡知无不言，言无不尽”。
“外界盛传，你小子是个不能修炼的废物，可是昨天聚贤楼的的事情，我们也有关注。
为什么看你表现，不像全无修为，你莫非隐藏了什么？”
“这…?”林琅天故意摆出一副为难的样子。
十七祖换上一副凶神恶煞的模样，似乎林琅天若无一个合理解释，便要当场灭杀的举动。
“唉，也罢，既然老祖问开了，小子我也不藏着掖着了，小子确实隐藏了修为，不过这样做也是有苦衷的”。
“各位老祖可能不知道林家的真实状况，我假装自己是个废人，其实是为了保命”
“自一出生，我便是天赋异禀，本该光芒荣耀加身，可惜天妒英才，受小人迫害”
“我还在娘胎，就被歹人伤害，挖走了大道圣心，以致我圣体有缺，出生先天不足，无法修炼”。
“若非我娘亲苦苦哀求陆家，最后得到一株灵药，给我服用，让我得以活命，，否则恐怕我早已死于非命”。
“即便我是废人，林家也有人处处与我们母子作对，一有机会恨不得弄死我，不想让我呆在林家”
“他们低估了圣体的能力，即便没有圣心，我的圣体也日渐成长，只可惜我没有资源服用，，也不敢暴露圣体能力半分，”
“因为我明白身为废物的我，别人都不愿意放过，要是知道我有修炼能力了，别人肯定直接对我下手”
“我绝对活不过第二天，敌人太强大了，强大到我只能仰人鼻息而苟活”。
林琅天神情黯淡，声沉语重，把自己在林家的遭遇说了出来，君家虽然早有调查，但当事人说出来，内心还是很震撼。
君家十八祖，十七祖两人对视一眼，也能看出林琅天并没有说谎，因为君家也有对他专门调查过。
众族老听完整件事的内幕，也是内心唏嘘不已，别人家的孩子能出个出色的后辈，恨不得当个祖宗供养。
而林家倒好，圣体都舍得残害，要知道就算是君家，年轻一辈就只有一个君傲天是圣体。
另外三大圣子也不过是王体，灵体而已。
“林琅天，你现在什么实力”君有情好奇问道；
众人也显为好奇，都屏息凝气的想了解林琅天的实力。
“我现在只有尊者境的实力”林琅天故意散发出一股尊者境大成的气息。
“吸”众人倒吸冷气，虽然尊者境圣在座的诸位，算不得什么，君家修为最差的也是尊者境巅峰以上。
但那是从小就开始培养，各种资源不断的供给，而林琅天呢？啥都没有，恐怕就连打坐修炼，都得偷偷摸摸的干吧！
“你为什么能在林家众多人面前隐藏修为，而不被人发现，林家对君家来说虽然不咋滴，但至圣境的人物还是有的”。
“回凛老祖，这就是圣体的能力了，大道圣体的能力，在于对道则的领悟与法力运用。
只要我不运行法力，它就可以隐藏在身体深处，不被人发现”
林琅天心中却想，“反正你们没见过别的大道圣体，不知道大道圣体的奥妙，随我怎么编”

Chapter 21 How should I cooperate with the performance (Page 1)
Seeing Lin Langtian's statement, Jun Youqing snorted secretly in his heart, "I guess you have a good sense of character," but he said in his mouth:
"Since Mr. Lin agrees, then the matter is settled, how about holding the wedding tomorrow?"
"Everything depends on father," Jun Yixue said shyly;
Jun Youqing looked at Lin Langtian, and Lin Langtian immediately understood, "But it's up to Uncle Jun to make the decision. I won't have any objections."
"Yeah." Seeing the situation developing as expected, Jun Youqing also breathed a sigh of relief.
"Okay, regarding the resolution of the wedding matter, Lin family boy, I have something I want to ask you about." The Eighteenth Patriarch finally spoke up.
Lin Langtian suddenly felt like something bad had happened. Fortunately, he already had a case against him, otherwise he didn't know what would happen.
"Eighteenth Patriarch, if you have any doubts, I will tell you everything you know."
"There are rumors from the outside world that your boy is a waste who cannot practice cultivation, but we are also paying attention to what happened in Juxian Tower yesterday.
Why don't you act like you have no cultivation at all? Are you hiding something? "
"This...?" Lin Langtian deliberately looked embarrassed.
The Seventeenth Ancestor put on a fierce look, as if Lin Langtian was going to kill him on the spot if he didn't have a reasonable explanation.
"Well, it doesn't matter. Now that the ancestor has asked, I won't hide the kid anymore. The kid does hide his cultivation, but there are difficulties in doing so."
"Ancestors may not know the real situation of the Lin family. I pretended to be a useless person, but actually it was to save my life."
"Since I was born, I have been gifted. I should have been blessed with brilliance and glory. Unfortunately, God is jealous of talents and I am persecuted by villains."
"When I was still in my mother's womb, I was harmed by a gangster who poached the Sacred Heart of the Dao. As a result, my holy body was missing and I was born with a congenital deficiency that prevented me from cultivating."
"If my mother hadn't begged the Lu family and finally got a magical elixir for me to take and keep me alive, otherwise I might have died a long time ago."
"Even if I am a useless person, there are still people in the Lin family who are always against our mother and son. They want to kill me whenever they get the chance. They don't want me to stay in the Lin family."
"They underestimated the power of the Holy Body. Even without the Sacred Heart, my Holy Body is growing day by day. It's a pity that I don't have the resources to take it, and I don't dare to expose even half of the power of the Holy Body."
"Because I understand that as a waste, others are not willing to let me go. If they know that I have the ability to practice, others will definitely attack me directly."
"I will never survive the next day. The enemy is too powerful, so powerful that I can only survive by relying on others."
Lin Langtian looked gloomy and spoke in a deep voice as he told what happened to him in the Lin family. Although the Jun family had already investigated it, the person involved was still shocked when he told it.
The eighteenth and seventeenth ancestors of the Jun family looked at each other and could tell that Lin Langtian was not lying, because the Jun family had also investigated him specifically.
After hearing the whole story, the clan elders were filled with sadness. If other people's children could produce outstanding children, they wished they could be supported by their ancestors.
As for the Lin family, they are willing to mutilate the Holy Body. You must know that even in the Jun family, there is only one Jun Aotian in the younger generation who is the Holy Body.
The other three holy sons are just king bodies and spiritual bodies.
"Lin Langtian, what is your current strength?" Jun Youqing asked curiously;
Everyone was also curious, and they all held their breath to understand Lin Langtian's strength.
"I only have the strength of the Venerable Realm now." Lin Langtian deliberately exuded an aura of being a master of the Venerable Realm.
"Suck!" Everyone gasped. Although all of you who are Venerable Realm Saints here are nothing, the ones with the lowest cultivation level in the Jun family are above the peak of the Venerable Realm.
But that was cultivated from an early age, with a constant supply of various resources, but what about Lin Langtian? There is nothing, I’m afraid even meditating and practicing must be done secretly!
"Why can you hide your cultivation in front of so many people in the Lin family without being discovered? Although the Lin family is not that good to the Jun family, there are still some people in the Holy Realm."
"Ancestor Hui Lin, this is the power of the Holy Body. The power of the Holy Body of the Dao lies in the understanding of the principles of Tao and the use of magic power.
As long as I don't use my magic power, it can be hidden deep in my body without being discovered."
Lin Langtian thought in his heart, "Anyway, you have never seen other Dao Sacred Body, and you don't know the mystery of Dao Sacred Physique. Just make it up as I like."
